title: Sell Mineral Rights in Dodge, ND
metaTitle: Sell Mineral Rights in Dodge, ND
metaDescription: Dodge sits in core Dunn County near Killdeer. See what dense Bakken and Three Forks spacing in this part of the county means for your family's interest.
heroLead: Dodge is a small Dunn County town sitting inside some of the most consistently drilled Bakken and Three Forks ground in the entire basin.
intro: Dunn County's core position in the Williston Basin means a tract near Dodge has a real chance of sitting inside an active, multi-well spacing unit, even if the family holding it hasn't heard from an operator in years. Ownership here typically traces to early farm and ranch homesteads, split across generations the way it has across most of rural Dunn County.

We encourage Dodge-area owners to check their legal description against current production records before assuming an old lease means nothing is happening, since operators in this part of the county have continued adding wells to existing units well after the original lease was signed.

sections.heading: Dodge Sits Inside Dunn County's Productive Core
paragraphs: Spacing units around Dodge have seen substantial horizontal development targeting both the Bakken and Three Forks benches, consistent with the rest of core Dunn County. A tract here is more likely than not to have some drilling history on it, whether recent or from earlier in the county's development.

sections.heading: What a Dodge-Area Royalty Statement Can Involve
paragraphs: Because units in this part of the county often hold more than one well, a Dodge-area statement can show production and deductions itemized separately across several laterals sharing the same legal description, which is normal for core acreage and worth reading carefully rather than skimming the total.

sections.heading: Confirming Your Fraction Before Any Decision
paragraphs: The Dunn County Recorder's office, based in Manning, holds the deed and probate chain for tracts throughout the county, including Dodge. Pulling that record is the surest way to confirm your exact current fraction before weighing a lease renewal or an offer.

faqs.question: Is Dodge, ND inside the core Bakken play?
faqs.answer: Yes, Dodge sits within Dunn County's core Bakken and Three Forks development area, one of the more heavily drilled parts of the basin.

faqs.question: Why might my Dodge statement show multiple wells?
faqs.answer: Multi-well spacing units are common in this part of Dunn County, so one legal description can generate production from several horizontal wells at once.

faqs.question: Where are Dunn County mineral records kept?
faqs.answer: The Dunn County Recorder's office in Manning holds deed, lease, and probate records for tracts throughout the county, including Dodge.

faqs.question: Does an old lease on my Dodge property mean drilling has stopped?
faqs.answer: Not necessarily. Operators in core Dunn County have continued adding wells to existing units well after the original lease date, so checking current status is worth doing before assuming nothing is happening.
